description_en: Detects the positions and content of QR codes in an image
description_zh: 检测图片中二维码的位置和内容
kebab_example: aliyun imm detect-image-qr-codes --project immimagetest --image-uri oss://imm-test/testcases/QRcodetest.jpg --api-version 2017-09-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DetectImageQRCodes

parameters.help_en:
The OSS URI of the image.

The OSS URI follows the format `oss://bucket/object`, where bucket is the name of the OSS bucket in the same region as the current project, and object is the file path
parameters.help_zh:
图片的OSS URI。

OSS地址规则为`oss://bucket/object`，其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的OSS Bucket名称，object为文件路径
parameters.name: image_uri

ImageUri.description_en: The OSS URI of the image

QRCodes.description_en:
The detected QR code information.

Currently, only one QR code can be returned at most
QRCodes.description_zh:
识别出的二维码信息。

目前最多只能返回一个二维码

Content.description_en: The content of the QR code

QRCodeBoundary.description_en: The bounding box of the QR code

Height.description_en: The height of the QR code bounding box. Unit: px
Height.description_zh: 二维码位置框高度。单位为px

Left.description_en: The X coordinate of the top-left vertex, which is the distance from the left edge. Unit: px
Left.description_zh: 顶点X坐标，距离左端距离。单位为px

Top.description_en: The Y coordinate of the top-left vertex, which is the distance from the top edge. Unit: px
Top.description_zh: 顶点Y坐标，距离顶端距离。单位为px

Width.description_en: The width of the QR code bounding box. Unit: px
Width.description_zh: 二维码位置框宽度。单位为px
